issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'Gaal son of Ebed' (גַּעַל בֶּן עֶבֶד), but the Chinese renders '贖，那僕人的兒子' — '贖' is not a transliteration of Gaal, and '那僕人的兒子' ('son of that servant') mistranslates the proper name Ebed (עֶבֶד, meaning 'servant') as a common noun, losing the personal name Gaal entirely.
